---
description: "Create a persistent accessible design-system specification for an admin panel, portal, CRM, or SaaS product"
name: "PanelForge Design System"
argument-hint: "Describe the product, audience, brand personality, and density"
agent: "agent"
---

Create a design-system specification using [`design-engine/README.md`](../../design-engine/README.md), [`design-engine/design-system.md`](../../design-engine/design-system.md), and [`templates/design-system.md`](../../templates/design-system.md).

Return:
- Primary style and optional secondary influence with rationale.
- Semantic color, typography, spacing, layout, radius, elevation, and breakpoint tokens.
- Component language and required interaction states.
- Responsive, accessibility, reduced-motion, and performance fallbacks.
- Rules that keep admin, user, and CRM surfaces consistent.

Inspect existing project tokens first. Do not mix visual styles without documenting compatibility.
